tracks.title: Unmasked
tracks.lyrics:
I keep fooling myself
With each mask that I wear
This burden I must bear
I'm stuck in disguise
With All these white lies
All these white lies

I am ready... for whatever may come around
Everything I do is for
The dearest to my heart

But I often have these thoughts
That I'm just playing my roles
Like an actor in the theater of life
With no way for a freedom's cry

Every now and then
I try to put them away
I scratch them hard till I bleed
But I feel that's what I need
From inside I have to fight my way out
Through the pain till I see the glimmer of light

I keep fooling myself
With All these white lies
All these white lies

Mesmerized... by the way of life
That everyone of us
Have to play our parts
How many more fights await me?
On this path I walk persistently
How many more cuts will I take?
Just to keep my loved ones safe

Every now and then
I try to put them away
I scratch them hard till I bleed
But I feel that's what I need
From inside I have to fight my way out
Through the pain till I see the glimmer of light

That's just the way humans are
Like actors we play
In the theater of life
That's just the way humans are
The masks we wear
Are the burden we bear
Sacrificing ourselves
For the ones we try
So hard to protect

Don't forget who you really are (really are)
Take them out, embrace your scars
Face the picture your life has made
And don't let your identity fade
Don't let your identity fade

tracks.title: From The Ashes
tracks.lyrics:
Fell into deep hole of sadness
Nothing dear to hold on to
Just a fleeting glimpse of hope
That behind this wall

Behind this wall of numbness
Primal flame awaits
Can it melt the chain of heartache
Ignite the embers of desire
Relit the fire

Like a phoenix
From the ashes
You will live to see a new dawn
And when the night meets new day
Through the flames you'll find your way

From Ash to ash
But Avoid the dust
In ash you might find the ember
That can ignite the fire
Just feed it right

A small crack appeared in the wall
Could it be a breakthrough
I have to tear it brick by brick
Or I will never

Turn a page for new chapter
Make a vow with myself
To learn from all my mistakes
And have the courage to be born again

Like a phoenix
From the ashes
You will live to see a new dawn
And when the night meets new day
Through the flames you'll find your way

From Ash to ash
But Avoid the dust
In ash you might find the ember
That can ignite the fire
Just feed it right

Ash to ash dust to dust
The cycle never ends
The gift of life is precious
Don't let it go to waste
You Soon will be reborn
As someone else you never knew
Relit the fire
Or fade away
Relit the fire
Reincarnate

tracks.title: Rise
tracks.lyrics:
Like a tool in the hands of fate
Made of love and hate

What holds all facts and stays intact?
What would you hide or boast about?
I know for sure
My past will chase me down
I'll face the naked truth
With all its glory and flaws

Like a part of the game
I'm suspended in a frame

Through the raging storms
I'll find my way that I had lost
But I remember now
All my scars all that cost
I carried it all it's time to rise above
Rise above

What would you mean If time didn't exist?
A mere distant dream Which blurred in the mist
These questions speculations
Eternal calculation
Distracts you from your goal
So rise above it all!

Through the raging storms
I'll find my way that I had lost
But I remember now
All my scars all that cost
I carried it all it's time to rise above
Rise unbound

Like a part of the game
I'm suspended in a frame

A tool in the hands of fate
Made of love and hate

Through the raging storms
Found my way that I had lost
But I remember now
All my scars all that cost
I carried it all it's time to rise above
Rise above
Above it all!

tracks.title: Seed Of Doubt
tracks.lyrics:
After planting a seed of doubt
Shadow grows, leeches inside my mind

Silent plea an echo of the distant thought
Rotting inside in my brain
Now my insecurities are all I've got
And the madness is my friend
The more I think of you
My burden grows in size
Truths or lies, no distinction in sight
And all it took for me
Was a small seed of doubt

Am I crazy or slowly losing my mind
In my memories, your picture begins to rot

My dread is bigger with every single thought
I fear that after harvest there will be no way back
No way back

Am I crazy (am I crazy) or slowly losing my mind
In my memories, your picture begins to rot
Perpetual clash between truth and your lies
Is eating me from inside

The crop bore its fruit
Harvester's on its way
Such a small seed
Yet the yield is so high
Now I have to pay the price
For the lie you planted with uneasy doubt
If I can bring myself to trust ever again
If I can leave myself open
For someone new to come

Am I crazy (am I crazy) or slowly losing my mind
In my memories, your picture begins to rot
Perpetual clash between truth and your lies
Is eating me from inside

Now I'm overwhelmed with all the dreaded thoughts
I wish I never
Gave you all my heart
All my heart
All it took was a small seed of doubt

tracks.title: Waves
tracks.lyrics:
Waves of fear! As if my end is near
Distorted mind makes me feel like I am blind
Now the fear is gone, I am not alone
As you come to clear the clouds
Out of my mind, infested with doubts

With you
My anger fades
You fill my soul
With gentle confidence

We've come this far
We've raised the bar
To reach for the stars

Now I see all the things
That held me back from my dreams
All the struggles come to an end
With the touch of your hand
When we're together
All the things that stopped me
Are fading away
With your name engraved in my heart

Waves of hate! Clash with reason
I'm boiling inside but when I see you
The hate is gone because
I am not alone
As you are here to clear the clouds
Out of my mind, infested with doubts

Bound forever in every endeavor
Reaching for the sky, you and I

Now I see all the things
That held me back from my dreams
All the struggles come to an end
With the touch of your hand
When we're together
All the things that stopped me
Are fading away
With your name engraved in my heart

Light and dark
Marked in the sky
Fire and ice
Carved in your eyes
You and I

tracks.title: Party Time
tracks.lyrics:
It's Party Time

Don't resist, just lose your mind.
It's party time!
Don't freak out, just enjoy your time.

Wake up, it's morning — time to shine.
Sun has risen up,
But you are still in your bed,
Just rotting around,
Rotting around.

You chase for a high
Every single night,
But you should know
That in the long run,
It will fuck you up.

You look for something —
What you are looking for?
You look for something —
What you are looking for?
You look for something to distract your mind.
You look for something —
What you are looking for is...

Party time!
Don't resist, just lose your mind.
It's party time!
Don't freak out, just enjoy your time.

Am I going down
For a moment of fun?
Do I even like what I've become?
Justifying all the past mistakes
With some lame excuse for
A reason to keep on going wild.

But when I face the man in the mirror,
I see a victim of
The downward spiral.

Victim of the downward spiral,
Just a victim of the downward spiral.
I don't want to be a victim of the downward spiral —
I have to break this fucking downward spiral!

You look for something —
What you are looking for?
You look for something —
What you are looking for?
You look for something to distract your mind.
You look for something —
What you are looking for is...

Party time!
Don't resist, just lose your mind.
It's party time!
Don't freak out, just enjoy your time.

But avoid the downward spiral...
Do you want to be a victim of the downward spiral?
Don't be a victim!

tracks.title: Technophobia
tracks.lyrics:
It's fair to say that
The troubles we face
As humanity
We often try to fix
By the means of our
Technology

Did we go too far?
While being humans
Machines are used instead of us
Did we lose our minds
While being humans
We're shedding tears to generated art

To reach beyond the border of our imagination
We're trading souls for the world's automation

There is a threat that lies ahead
Push the button, cut the wire
Save us save us save
While we still can before it's too late
Just a meatsack with a brain
Do you want to be replaced?
Just an ape escaped from cave
Do you want to be a slave?

What purpose do you serve?
Are you optimized enough
To be not replaced yet?
I resent this future
Where I'm a useless waste of space
We should band together
And push back the wheel of fate

To reach beyond the border of our imagination
We're trading souls for the world of automation

There is a threat that lies ahead
Push the button, cut the wire
Save us save us save
While we still can before it's too late
Just a meatsack with a brain
Do you want to be replaced?
Just an ape escaped from cave
Do you want to be a slave?

Damnation through automation
Damnation through automation

tracks.lyrics:
Is it love or self preservation
That I feel from you
Can I keep myself alive
If I never learned how to live
I won't be the extension of your narcissism
A Hybrid of mixed personalities
Image of greatest hope
To fulfill dreams of someone else

You're casting a big shadow
When I'm looking for the sun
Cause it's not fun
Dreaming your dreams
Clipping my wings
Your influence on me is over
Set me free, let me be
Your influence is over
All your strings won't hold me no longer

I will fight this predestination

I will rip them out

Prepare to fight or die

tracks.lyrics:
Time kills, cold chills
Time kills, dead still

Rotten worms burrow deep, dripping venom within

Turning us to unusable dust
Don't know how long this can last

Everyone's destiny is a deep hole
In the ground
The last bell calls out a name
With a terrifying sound

Time kills, dead still

Friends will boast with a fiery cheer,

In the ground
The last bell calls out a name

Time… kills…
All… that lives…

In the ground
The last bell calls out a name
With a terrifying sound

The last bell called
But I refuse to hear its sound
My time has not yet come
So I will roam this earth
Until my final breath
